rejected_candidates.reason: Their analytic matrix-function and Jordan-form interfaces are not supplied by the compiled library. They cannot form T1 or T2, and formalizing the missing functional-calculus infrastructure would go beyond the proof material developed in this paper; Lemma 2.1 provides a direct self-contained T3.
The paper explicitly quotes these results from earlier sources rather than proving them here.
These are algorithm descriptions and stopping or reordering procedures, not standalone proved conclusions with the substantial formal proof required by a tier task.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Sections 3 and 6 error and preprocessing observations
rejected_candidates.reason: The displayed consequences are short recurrence, invariance, or conditioning arguments after their premises are assumed and do not meet the required difficulty.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Section 7 numerical experiments and Section 8 conclusions
rejected_candidates.reason: These are empirical comparisons and qualitative conclusions rather than universally proved theorem statements.

T1.decision: Skipped. No result proved in P36 can use exactly one substantial theorem from the importable frozen NumStability set. The compiled modules offer generic matrix infrastructure but no Schur-Parlett, Taylor matrix-function, Jordan, or strict-upper power theorem.

T2.decision: Skipped. No source proof can use at least two distinct substantial results from the importable frozen NumStability set. Combining generic matrix modules would not supply two paper-relevant shortcuts and would manufacture a dependency absent from the source.

T3.decision: Selected the componentwise part of Lemma 2.1. It requires a full entrywise matrix-product majorization, strict-upper band and nilpotence argument, and exactly truncated binomial expansion, while neither Mathlib nor NumStability provides the corresponding result.

selection_policy: Use only conclusions whose statements and supporting derivations are present in this paper.
Do not turn theorems quoted from earlier sources into tasks.
Do not count uncompiled Jordan, matrix-power, or Sylvester source modules as available to condition L.
Keep the full arbitrary-dimension truncation in Lemma 2.1 instead of extracting only a basic scalar inequality.
Keep every public definition paper-scoped and free of NumStability imports.
Assign tiers only after comparison with the complete frozen NumStability source, its importable compiled subset, and Mathlib.
